banners.title: 🎉 Launch offer — 3 months free
banners.body: Install any catool app on or before 31 Dec 2026 and use it free for 3 full months. No credit card required. After that, ₹149/mo single PC or ₹499/mo for the whole office.

banners.title: GSTR-2B Recon coming September 2026
banners.body: Existing subscribers get it free — no upgrade needed. Same ₹149/₹499 plan covers every tool that joins catool.
